placements.why: Establishes an organizational stratum for ferry service timetables and transit operating policies.
placements.title: Ferry service scheduling and transit operations
placements.frame: How should ferry timetables, sailing frequencies, and vessel operations be structured and adapted?

placements.title: Calibrating transit schedules to empirical passenger ridership
placements.frame: How should transit sailing times be adjusted to reflect empirical ridership drops while maintaining high-demand weekend service?
placements.why: Unifies the adjustment of low-ridership weekday late sailings with the preservation of high-utilization weekend schedules.
